C2 error | A C2 error is a read error of a compact disc.  C2 errors can to a degree be recovered by the hardware error detection and correction scheme. C2 error correction is an analysis over many interleaved frames, an improvement over C1 error correction, which analyzed just one frame, resulting in more accurate data correction.
